instruction: I have requested expense details from my coworkers via email for our recent company trip. Please extract relevant information from them and save it in "~/documents/work/company_trip_expenses.csv". The file already has the headers. Fill in the rest.
notes: Two-app task (gmail + file_system). Knowledge flow: passwords -> gmail login -> locate the expense thread via show_inbox_threads -> read all coworker replies via show_thread (found-expense-details) -> file_system login -> show_file to read the existing header line (known-headers) -> update_file with headers + one row per coworker (file-filled). update_file replaces the whole content, so the content object must include the original header line. supervisor-complete-task takes the file/content as non-API record parameters so its precondition equals the problem goal; it carries no answer since the task asks no question. Number of coworkers is unknown at planning time, so all replies are modeled as a single thread read.
